## Purpose
Package marker for the directory where generated tool modules are written.

## Responsibilities
A single comment line: "# Dynamic Tools — generated tool modules are stored here".

## Key elements
None.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
None. The registry writes `<name>_v<N>_<hash8>.py` files beside it, and the native seed writes `<name>_<hash8>.py`.

## Configuration
`DYNAMIC_TOOLS_DIR` (default `dynamic_tools`).

## Interactions
- **Written by:** `synthesis/registry.write_module` and `seed_native_tools`.

## Error handling and edge cases
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
The modules are loaded by file path with `importlib`, not as a package, so this marker is not strictly needed.

## How to rebuild this file
One comment line.

None.
